name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin
description: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) is a flagship rural housing scheme of the Ministry of Rural Development that aims to provide pucca houses with basic amenities to eligible rural households. The eligible universe is determined through SECC data and comprises houseless households and households living in zero, one, or two-room houses with kutcha walls and kutcha roofs, subject to a defined exclusion process.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 per unit for plain areas.
Financial assistance of ₹1,30,000 per unit for hilly areas, difficult areas and IAP districts, including Himalayan states, North-Eastern states and UT of Jammu & Kashmir.
Willing beneficiaries can avail institutional finance up to ₹70,000 at 3% lower interest rate.
Maximum principal amount for which subsidy can be sought is ₹2,00,000.
Minimum house size 25 sq m including dedicated hygienic cooking area.
Up to ₹12,000 assistance for toilets through convergence with SBM-G.
MGNREGA convergence: employment as unskilled labour at ₹90.95/day for 95 days as stated by the supplied source.
One LPG connection per house through PM Ujjwala convergence.
Convergence for piped drinking water, electricity, clean and efficient cooking fuel and waste management.
Electronic payments directly to Aadhaar-linked bank/post-office accounts.

rules.description: Applicant household must be part of the eligible universe as determined through SECC data. The eligible universe consists of houseless households and households living in zero, one, or two-room houses with kutcha walls and kutcha roofs, subject to the defined exclusion process. Automatic or compulsory inclusion covers: (1) households without shelter, (2) destitute or living on alms, (3) manual scavengers, (4) primitive tribal groups, and (5) legally released bonded labourers. Deprivation and prioritisation criteria — including no adult member between 16 and 59, female-headed household with no adult male member between 16 and 59, no literate adult above 25, disabled member with no able-bodied adult, and landless household deriving major income from manual casual labour — are used for prioritisation and not as mandatory AND eligibility rules.

exclusion_rules.description: Households owning a motorised two, three, or four-wheeler or a fishing boat are excluded.
Households owning mechanised three- or four-wheeler agricultural equipment are excluded.
Households having a Kisan credit card with a credit limit of ₹50,000 or more are excluded.
Households with a government employee are excluded.
Households with a government-registered non-agricultural enterprise are excluded.
Households with a family member earning above ₹10,000 monthly are excluded.
Households that pay income tax are excluded.
Households that pay professional tax are excluded.
Households owning a refrigerator are excluded.
Households owning a landline phone are excluded.
Households owning at least 2.5 acres of irrigated land with irrigation equipment are excluded.
Households owning at least 5 acres of irrigated land used for two or more crop seasons are excluded.
Households owning at least 7.5 acres of land with irrigation equipment are excluded.
Households living in a house with pucca walls and/or pucca roof are excluded.
Households living in a house with more than 2 rooms are excluded.
